name: Roadhouse Toast
description: Bacon-wrapped eggs on buttered low-carb toast, air-fried to crispy perfection.
instructions: Butter your bread.
Wrap bacon in circles around each slice.
Crack the eggs in your bacon circle.
Pepper on top.
Air fry at 190°C for 8 minutes.
Add mashed avocado.
Enjoy! This recipe makes two servings.

name: Shredded Breakfast Wraps
description: Chicken apple sausage, eggs and peppers wrapped in a toasted low-carb tortilla.
instructions: To an oiled pan, add diced onion and green bell pepper and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Once onions are sweating, add in your diced chicken apple sausage.
Push everything to the side of the pan and add six eggs, seasoning with pepper.
Mix everything and then add spoonfuls to a warm tortilla with cheese.
Fold sides and roll into a wrap.
For a crunchy wrap, toast it in the pan for a couple minutes.
Enjoy with Shredded Jalapeño Ranch. Makes about 3 wraps.

name: High-Protein Egg Bites
description: Blended eggs and cottage cheese baked into protein-packed muffin bites with bacon and spinach.
instructions: Crack a dozen eggs into a blender.
Add cottage cheese, salt and pepper to blender.
Blend it together.
Pour mixture into bowl.
Mix in bacon, spinach, and cheese.
Pour into muffin tray and bake at 190°C for 20 minutes.
Enjoy! This recipe makes 12 bites.

name: Egg Chicken Quesadilla
description: Egg white base with chicken, spinach and cheese folded in a low-carb tortilla.
instructions: Melt your pat of butter in a large pan on medium heat.
Add your egg whites and cook through.
Once whites begin to solidify, place large tortilla in pan.
Flip your tortilla: put lid on pan, turn pan upside down, then lower lid and slide tortilla off.
Once flipped, add salt, pepper, paprika, shredded cheese, spinach, and cooked chicken breast.
Fold and press down with spatula.
Remove from pan, slice into smaller pieces, and enjoy! Makes one large serving.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Wrap
description: Teriyaki-marinated air-fried chicken thighs with cabbage and carrots in a toasted wrap.
instructions: In a bowl, mix chicken thighs with teriyaki sauce, salt and pepper.
Air fry at 200°C for 15 minutes.
Slice cooked chicken.
Set out with warm tortilla, shredded carrots, and cabbage.
Put everything in your tortilla.
Fold into wrap.
Toast wrap in air fryer for 3 minutes. Makes about 4 wraps.

name: Lemon Pepper Gyros
description: Lemon-marinated air-fried chicken with hummus, cucumber, tomato and onion on warm pita.
instructions: In bowl, mix chicken breast with lemon zest, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Air fry at 200°C for 15 minutes.
Once cooked, slice chicken.
Spread hummus on a warm pita.
Add your chicken, tomato, onion, and cucumber.
Fold and enjoy! Makes about 3 gyros.

name: High-Protein Grilled Cheese
description: Rotisserie chicken and gouda melted between low-carb bread slices.
instructions: Butter bread.
Add cheese.
Add shredded chicken.
Air fry at 190°C or cook in lightly oiled pan on each side until golden brown.
Slice and enjoy! Makes one serving.

name: Carnivore Quesadilla
description: Seasoned carne asada with oaxaca cheese in a toasted low-carb tortilla.

ingredients.name: Salt, pepper, garlic powder, chili lime seasoning

instructions: Season carne asada with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and chili lime seasoning.
Cook for a few minutes on each side until browned.
Add tortilla to the asada pan with oaxaca cheese and sliced carne asada.
Place second tortilla on top and flip, cooking both sides evenly.
Slice and enjoy! Makes one large serving.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
description: Buffalo-marinated air-fried chicken with lettuce, tomato and cheese in a toasted tortilla.
instructions: Add buffalo sauce, minced garlic, salt and pepper to chicken breasts.
Stir together and marinate a few minutes.
Air fry at 195°C for 15 minutes.
Slice chicken into strips.
Warm tortilla and add cheese, chicken, lettuce, and tomato.
Roll wrap and toast in air fryer for 5 minutes.
Makes about 3 wraps.

name: Orange Honey Chicken Bowls
description: Orange-honey marinated chicken thighs over quinoa with avocado.

ingredients.name: Boiled quinoa or microwavable quinoa packet

instructions: Combine orange juice, honey, garlic, chili paste, salt and pepper.
Fork chicken thighs and pour in marinade. Let sit 10 minutes.
Air fry at 195°C for 15 minutes.
Dice up the chicken.
Add to a bowl with quinoa.
Add avocado and Shredded Jalapeño Ranch.
Makes about 1 large bowl.

name: Chili Sesame Beef Bowl
description: Seasoned ground beef with sesame and sweet chili sauce over rice with avocado and pickles.
instructions: Cook diced onion in oiled pan until softened.
Add ground beef, then salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and chili paste.
Near end of cooking, add sesame seeds and sweet chili sauce to taste.
Add beef to a bowl with white rice, avocado, and pickles.
Enjoy! Makes one serving.

name: White Cheddar Turkey Burgers
description: Lean turkey patties with garlic, chili paste and white cheddar on a toasted bun.
instructions: Dice a red onion.
Combine red onion, ground turkey, salt, pepper, paprika, minced garlic, chili paste, and bread crumbs.
Form patties.
Cook in oiled pan on medium heat.
After flipping, add white cheddar cheese. Cover with lid to melt.
Add mashed avocado to toasted bun.
Place turkey patty over top. Makes about 4 burgers.

name: Honey Garlic Salmon Bowls
description: Honey soy glazed air-fried salmon over rice with avocado, carrots, and cucumber.
instructions: Brush salmon with oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, honey and soy sauce.
Air fry at 205°C for 10 minutes.
Add to bowl with rice, carrots, cucumber, and avocado.
Enjoy!

name: Pineapple Pork Tacos
description: Ground pork with crushed pineapple and a lemon crema with quick-pickled onion.

ingredients.name: Salt, pepper, cayenne, garlic powder, paprika

instructions: Add crushed pineapple to oiled pan on medium heat.
Add half the red onion, then ground pork and seasonings.
Cook until browned and set aside.
Put remaining onion, sliced radish, and lemon juice in bowl. Microwave 45 seconds.
Add lemon zest and sour cream to bowl and stir.
Add cooked pork and pickled onion mixture.
Makes about 3 servings (6 tacos).

name: Minotaur Munchies
description: Seasoned ground beef with eggs and rice in a hearty one-pan meal.
instructions: Cook ground beef in oiled pan, seasoning with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder.
Once halfway cooked, add 4 eggs and stir to cook through.
Add cooked rice and roma tomato, stir to combine.
Add to bowl and top with hot sauce.
Makes two servings.

name: Shredded Jalapeño Ranch
description: Creamy blended jalapeño ranch sauce made with Greek yogurt.
instructions: Blend all ingredients together.
One serving is about 2 tbsp.

name: Ole Reliable Sauce
description: Quick 4-ingredient sauce with avocado oil, dijon, sriracha and hot honey.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl or shake in an airtight container.
Makes one serving.

name: Shredded Honey Mustard
description: Greek yogurt-based honey mustard sauce with dijon and white vinegar.
instructions: Mix all ingredients together.
Store in airtight container.
One serving is about 2 tbsp.

name: Honey Chicken Wraps
description: Honey taco-seasoned chicken thighs with cheese, red onion and spinach in toasted tortillas.
instructions: Mix chicken thighs with oil, taco seasoning, black pepper, and honey.
Air fry at 200°C for 15 minutes.
Slice chicken and add to warm tortilla with cheese, red onion, spinach.
Wrap it up.
Toast in air fryer for 3-4 minutes until tortilla browns.
Wrap extras in foil and refrigerate for up to a week.
Makes about 4 servings.

name: Protein Penne Spicy Meatballs
description: Ground turkey meatballs air-fried and served with protein penne in rosé tomato sauce.
instructions: Mash ground turkey with garlic, chili paste, salt, pepper, parsley, egg, and bread crumbs.
Form about 9 balls.
Air fry at 205°C for 10 minutes.
While meatballs cook, boil protein pasta until cooked through.
Heat tomato sauce and add meatballs, stirring to absorb flavor.
Add cooked pasta and stir everything together.
Store in meal prep containers. Makes about 4 servings.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken Fried Rice
description: Honey garlic sesame chicken with egg whites, veggies and rice for meal prep.

ingredients.name: Boiled white rice or microwavable rice packet

instructions: Cube chicken and mix with salt, pepper, honey, soy sauce, garlic, and sesame oil.
Cook in pan. Once cooked, remove chicken.
In same pan, cook frozen veggies then push to side and cook egg whites.
Mix veggies and egg whites, add rice and drizzle with soy sauce.
Add chicken and mix everything together.
Divide into meal prep containers. Makes about 4 servings.

name: Rosemary Garlic Sirloin Roast
description: Slow-cooked sirloin roast with potatoes, carrots and a savory herb broth.

ingredients.name: Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, dried parsley, chopped rosemary

instructions: Grab a crock pot or slow cooker.
Drizzle oil and spread baby potatoes, diced onion, baby carrots, and cubed butter.
Add sirloin roast on top.
Mix beef broth, vinegar, soy sauce, worcestershire, and all spices in a bowl. Pour over roast.
Close lid and cook on low for 8-10 hours.
Once cooked, shred sirloin and return to pot, stirring everything together.
Makes about 5 servings.

name: Hot Honey Chicken Quinoa
description: Blackened air-fried chicken with quinoa drizzled in Ole Reliable Sauce.

ingredients.name: Oil, salt, pepper, paprika, blackened seasoning

instructions: Season chicken with oil, salt, pepper, paprika, and blackened seasoning.
Air fry at 200°C for 15 minutes.
Make Ole Reliable Sauce by stirring together avocado oil, dijon, sriracha, and hot honey.
Slice cooked chicken and place in meal prep container next to quinoa.
Pour sauce over top and enjoy!

name: Chocolate Cherry Protein Smoothie
description: Rich chocolate and cherry protein smoothie with Greek yogurt and peanut butter powder.
instructions: Blend all ingredients together.
Garnish with dark chocolate pieces and hemp seeds if desired.
Makes one serving.

name: Wild Berry Cutting Smoothie
description: Dairy-free berry smoothie with oats and double protein powder for cutting phases.
instructions: Blend all ingredients together.
Makes one serving.

name: Feel Better Smoothie
description: Immunity-boosting smoothie with ginger, orange, pineapple, spinach and Greek yogurt.
instructions: Blend all ingredients together.
Enjoy! Makes one serving.

name: Giga Smoothie
description: 100g protein mega smoothie with berries, frozen banana, Greek yogurt and vanilla protein.
instructions: Blend all ingredients together.
Makes one large serving.

name: Vegan Chocolate Mousse
description: Thick blended tofu, dates and cocoa mousse — vegan, high protein and indulgent.
instructions: Blend everything together.
Makes one large serving.

name: Strawberry Coco Progurt
description: Greek yogurt mixed with chocolate protein powder, topped with fresh strawberries.
instructions: Mix Greek yogurt and protein powder vigorously until thoroughly combined.
Top with fresh strawberries.
Makes one large serving.

name: Jacked Banana Bread
description: High-protein banana bread with plant-based protein powder and Reese's peanut butter chips.
instructions: Mash 3 old bananas.
Mix wet ingredients: milk, apple cider vinegar, and vanilla extract.
Add dry ingredients: flour, protein powder, and brown sugar. Mix together.
Fold in Reese's peanut butter chips.
Pour into bread pan lined with parchment paper.
Bake at 190°C for 45 minutes.
Makes about 7 servings.

name: Ripped Reese's Bowl
description: Blended peanut butter chocolate protein smoothie bowl — like a Reese's in a bowl.
instructions: Blend all ingredients together.
Pour into a bowl.
Garnish with a little dark chocolate.
Makes one large serving.

name: Balsamic Sprouts
description: Brussels sprouts tossed in balsamic, olive oil and hot honey, air-fried until caramelized.

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts, halved and stems removed
Hot honey or low-cal brown sugar

instructions: Slice sprouts in half and cut off stems.
Mix in bowl with oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, pepper, paprika, and hot honey.
Set on oven-safe tray and air fry at 190°C for 15 minutes.
Transfer to bowl and enjoy! Makes about two servings.

name: Jacked Chicken Nuggets
description: Ground chicken nuggets breaded in nutritional yeast and breadcrumbs, air-fried.
instructions: Mix ground chicken with salt, pepper, onion powder, and paprika.
Combine nutritional yeast and bread crumbs to form breading.
Using your hands, form nuggets and coat in breading.
Set coated nuggets on oven-safe tray.
Air fry at 205°C for 10 minutes.
Makes about 9 nuggets.

name: The 5-Minute Pizza
description: Quick pita pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella and turkey pepperoni in the air fryer.
instructions: Spoon pizza sauce onto pita bread.
Add cheese and turkey pepperoni.
Air fry at 205°C for 4 minutes.
Slice and enjoy! Makes one serving.

name: Easy Protein Tortilla
description: Homemade 2-ingredient protein tortillas made from Greek yogurt and flour.
instructions: Mix Greek yogurt, flour, and salt with a spoon.
Transfer to a floured surface and knead to form a dough.
Cut into 6 smaller balls of dough.
Roll dough balls into flat tortillas using a rolling pin.
Cook in oiled pan on medium heat until browned on either side.
Makes about 6 tortillas.

name: Anabolic French Toast
description: Chef Greg's iconic high-protein take on a classic North American breakfast. Fluffy egg-white-soaked toast served with blueberries and low-calorie syrup.
instructions: In a bowl, add egg whites, sweetener, cinnamon, and vanilla extract. Whisk until spices are evenly distributed.
Heat a griddle over low-medium heat. Spray with cooking spray.
Dip bread slices into egg white mixture and transfer to pan.
Spoon any leftover egg white mixture into the bread. Let it absorb slowly to get fluffy.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Serve with blueberries and low-calorie syrup (not included in macros).

name: French Toast Blueberry Pancakes
description: A blended French toast batter turned into fluffy blueberry pancakes. High protein with a classic North American breakfast feel.
instructions: In a blender, add bread slices, egg whites, guar/xanthan gum, sweetener, vanilla extract, and cinnamon.
Blend on high until mixture is uniform. Transfer to an airtight container.
Optional: let sit in refrigerator for 2-3 hours for better binding.
Heat griddle over low-medium heat. Spray with cooking spray. Add mixture and let sit 1-2 minutes until edges appear cooked.
Add blueberries to pancake in the pan.
Once edges brown and pancake looks 2/3 cooked through, flip and cook another 1-2 minutes.
Serve with low-calorie syrup or leftover blueberries.

name: Apple Protein Pancakes
description: A delicious combo of pancakes, apple pie flavour, and gains. High-protein, gluten-free friendly batter packed with rolled oats, cottage cheese, and apples.
instructions: Blend all ingredients for 30 seconds until a uniform consistency is achieved.
Optional: transfer to airtight container and let sit in refrigerator for 4 hours for thicker batter.
Heat griddle over low-medium heat. Spray with cooking spray. Add mixture and let sit 1-2 minutes until edges appear cooked through.
Flip and finish cooking.
Serve with toppings of choice (not included in macros).

name: Banana Protein Pancakes
description: Banana foster meets pancakes meets gains. High-protein gluten-free pancakes made with overripe banana, cottage cheese, and egg whites.
instructions: Blend all ingredients for 30 seconds until a uniform consistency is achieved.
Optional: transfer to airtight container and let sit in refrigerator for 4 hours for thicker batter.
Heat griddle over low-medium heat. Spray with cooking spray. Add mixture and let sit 1-2 minutes until edges appear cooked through.
Flip and finish cooking.
Serve with toppings of choice (not included in macros).

name: Anabolic Hamburger
description: A high-protein, lower-calorie take on a classic hamburger using extra lean ground beef, low-calorie gravy, and white bread.
instructions: Form a patty with ground beef, salt and pepper and any other seasonings to taste.
Heat a griddle over low-medium heat. Spray with cooking spray. Cook beef patty on both sides to medium doneness.
Heat gravy in a microwaveable bowl.
Stack veggies and patty on bread. Add gravy on top of the patty.
Serve with mustard or low-calorie ketchup (not included in macros).

name: Anabolic Chicken Burger
description: A lean, high-protein chicken burger on white bread with veggies and low-calorie gravy. Simple, filling, and great for a cut.
instructions: Optionally marinate chicken overnight with seasonings to taste.
Heat a griddle over low-medium heat. Spray with cooking spray. Cook chicken breast on both sides until cooked through.
Heat gravy in a microwaveable bowl.
Stack veggies and chicken on bread. Add gravy on top.
Serve with mustard or low-calorie ketchup (not included in macros).

name: Anabolic Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: A high-protein grilled cheese using ICON Meals protein bread, fat-free cheese, and low-fat butter. Classic comfort food for your gains.
instructions: Heat a griddle over low heat and add low-calorie butter to pan.
Add 2 slices of bread to the pan and add cheese on top.
Eat as a closed sandwich or as two open face sides, whichever you prefer.

name: PB2 and Jam Sandwich
description: A high-protein twist on a classic peanut butter and jelly sandwich using PB2 powder and protein bread to slash calories while keeping the taste.
instructions: Toast bread slices in the toaster until lightly brown and crisp.
Mix PB2 powder in a bowl with 1 tbsp water and stir until even consistency.
Spread PB2 mixture on bread slices then add jam.
Eat as a closed sandwich or open face. Enjoy!

name: NuPasta Chicken Stir Fry
description: A low-calorie, high-protein stir fry using zero-calorie NuPasta, chicken breast, and veggies. Fast, filling, and great for a cut.
instructions: Cook NuPasta according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat. Spray with cooking spray. Add veggies and chicken and sauté until cooked through. Add spices to taste.
Add cooked NuPasta and pasta sauce to the pan and sauté together for a few minutes.
Serve and eat altogether in a bowl.

name: Protein P28 Pizza
description: A high-protein mini pizza on P28 flatbread with ground bison, fat-free cheese, and low-fat pizza sauce. Satisfying and macro-friendly.
instructions: Heat a frying pan over medium heat. Add cooking spray and sauté onions, mushrooms, and peppers until cooked through. Add ground bison and sauté until fully cooked.
Toast P28 flatbread in oven at 300°F on a baking sheet for 3 minutes. Remove and let sit.
Add all toppings to the flatbread with cheese slices on top.
Place back in oven for another 3 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Cauliflower Mashed Potatoes
description: A lower-calorie, high-volume mashed potato alternative blending potatoes and cauliflower with fat-free sour cream. Great side dish for a cut.
instructions: Boil 4 quarts of salted water. Add potatoes and cook until fully cooked through. Drain and add to blender.
Separately, boil cauliflower until cooked. Drain and add to blender.
Add baking powder, spices, half the sour cream, and guar gum to blender. Pulse blend until smooth.
Serve with remaining fat-free sour cream and preferred spices.

name: Protein Chips and Guacamole
description: A guilt-free Mexican-inspired snack with homemade guacamole and crispy protein flatbread chips. Vegan, high-fibre, and delicious.
instructions: Slice avocado into cubes. Dice tomatoes, onions, and jalapenos. Place all in one bowl and mash with a spoon or pestle.
Add lime juice, salt and pepper to taste.
Place Flatout ProteinUP wrap on a baking sheet. Slice wrap into 1.5-inch squares.
Toast in oven for 3 minutes until crispy like tortilla chips.
Serve guacamole alongside chips.

name: Cottage Cheese Chocolate Protein Pudding
description: A creamy, high-protein chocolate pudding made with cottage cheese, almond milk, whey protein, and Jell-O pudding mix. Perfect anabolic dessert.
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend for 3 minutes on medium-high speed until a smooth consistency is achieved.
Transfer to an airtight refrigerator-safe container.
Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to eat. Makes 9 servings.

name: Blueberry Protein Shake
description: A quick and easy high-protein blueberry shake. One of Chef Greg's go-to post-workout options — thick, creamy, and low calorie.
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend for 1 minute on medium-high speed until smooth.
Scrape sides and pulse again if needed. Add more ice or water to reach desired consistency.
Pour into a mug and consume immediately.

name: Strawberry Protein Shake
description: A refreshing, creamy strawberry protein shake. Simple ingredients, high protein, and great as a post-workout shake or snack.
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend for 1 minute on medium-high speed until smooth.
Scrape sides and pulse again if needed.
Pour into a mug and consume immediately.

name: Vanilla Berry Proteinsicles
description: Frozen vanilla and mixed berry protein popsicles. High-protein, low-calorie, and a perfect anabolic dessert or snack from the freezer.
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Pulse blend on medium-high speed until smooth. Push ingredients down with a spoon as needed.
Transfer evenly across 4 popsicle trays.
Freeze for at least 2 hours before serving.

name: PB2 Chocolate Chip Protein Cookies
description: High-protein, low-fat chocolate chip peanut butter cookies. Made with PB2, oats, and whey protein — a batch of guilt-free cookies to keep in the fridge.
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 375°F.
Grind rolled oats in a blender until powdery.
Combine and mix all dry ingredients in a large bowl with a whisk.
Combine almond milk and VitaFiber in a bowl. Heat in microwave on high for 45 seconds.
Add egg whites to the almond milk/VitaFiber bowl and mix.
Add all wet ingredients to the dry ingredients bowl. Stir until a uniform pasty consistency.
Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. Create 4-8 cookies with batter.
Bake for 12 minutes. Remove and let stand until desired temperature. Eat warm or cold.
